version: LOCK 51 V1 (9 Nov 2026) - the finale: the last page and your choice
builds_on: LOCK 3 the scholar's pages, LOCKs 49-50. Design reference (not shown): Quran 20:114 (my Lord, increase me in knowledge).

missions.title: The last page
missions.kicker: The hard year · The last page
missions.button: Idris has something to show you

a.text: When Jalal's storehouse was emptied, a porter found a page folded into a crack in the wall. He brought it to Idris. It is in the scholar's hand - the last page of his notebook, the one he wrote on the night his caravan was robbed.

b.text: Idris reads it twice before he can speak. “He wrote: whoever finds these pages, they are not mine to keep and not yours. Give them to the people.”

missions.title: Your choice
missions.button: Idris asks what you will do now

a.text: The rain has come and the fields are green again. The House of Learning has asked you to stay and look after the scholar's notebook. A letter from home asks when you are coming back.

choices.label: Go home, and come back every year

stay.text: You give the notebook to the House of Learning with your own hands, and they give you a room above the library. River Market goes on around you. It always will.

home.text: Idris walks you to the quay where you landed. “Come back at Ramadan,” he says. The boat pulls out, and Ilmara gets small behind you - and then you remember you can come back whenever you like.
